title: Finite locally free two-level refinement of an fppf covering
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\{S_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ be a small fppf covering [def-pc-fppf-site]. There exist a Zariski open covering $S=\bigcup_j U_j$, surjective finite locally free morphisms $W_j\to U_j$, Zariski open coverings $W_j=\bigcup_k W_{j,k}$, and surjective finite locally free morphisms $T_{j,k}\to W_{j,k}$ such that each composite $T_{j,k}\to S$ factors through some $S_i\to S$. Empty schemes and empty indexing families are allowed.

proof.text: Handle the empty base first. If $S=\varnothing$, choose the empty Zariski covering and hence no $W_j$ or $T_{j,k}$; every requested condition is vacuous. If $I=\varnothing$, joint surjectivity in [def-pc-fppf-site] forces $S=\varnothing$. Thus below assume $S\ne\varnothing$. All indexing sets and choices are taken within [def-weil-size-convention].

source.place: Tag 05WN, statement, empty cases and size convention.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-fppf-etale-finite-free-refinement] to the given small fppf covering, with no hypothesis on quasi-compactness or separatedness of $S$. Write the resulting etale covering as $e_a:S\prime_a\to S$, its surjective finite locally free maps as $p_a:V_a\to S\prime_a$, and the refinement maps as $r_a:V_a\to S_{i(a)}$. In particular $f_{i(a)}\circ r_a=e_a\circ p_a$.

source.place: Tag 05WN, lemma-dominate-fppf, first paragraph; Tag 0DET, lemma-dominate-fppf-etale-locally.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-etale-finite-free-open-refinement] to the jointly surjective etale family $\{e_a\}$. This gives $S=\bigcup_jU_j$, surjective finite locally free $q_j:W_j\to U_j$, open coverings $W_j=\bigcup_kW_{j,k}$, and maps $h_{j,k}:W_{j,k}\to S\prime_{a(j,k)}$ over $S$. With $u_j:U_j\hookrightarrow S$ and $\iota_{j,k}:W_{j,k}\hookrightarrow W_j$, their defining equality is $e_{a(j,k)}\circ h_{j,k}=u_j\circ q_j\circ\iota_{j,k}$.

source.place: Tag 05WN, lemma-dominate-fppf, second paragraph, invoking Tag 02LI, remark-topologies.

proof.text: For each $j,k$, set $a=a(j,k)$ and form $T_{j,k}=V_a\times_{S\prime_a}W_{j,k}$ with projections $v_{j,k}:T_{j,k}\to V_a$ and $t_{j,k}:T_{j,k}\to W_{j,k}$ using [def-pc-fibre-product]. The equality $p_a\circ v_{j,k}=h_{j,k}\circ t_{j,k}$ is the fibre-product relation. The map $t_{j,k}$ is the base change of $p_a$. By [def-pc-finite-locally-free], $p_a$ is finite, flat, and locally of finite presentation. These three properties pass to $t_{j,k}$ by clause (a) of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-morphism-permanence], [lem-weil-pbc-flat-morphism-base-change], and clause (3) of [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence], respectively. No qcqs hypothesis is needed for that node's clause (3). Thus $t_{j,k}$ is finite locally free by the same definition. It is surjective by [lem-weil-pbc-surjective-base-change].

source.place: Tag 05WN, lemma-dominate-fppf, final sentence; morphisms.tex Tags 01WL, 01U9, 01TS, 01S1 (base-change properties).

proof.text: The required factorization through a member of the original covering is the actual morphism $r_a\circ v_{j,k}:T_{j,k}\to S_{i(a)}$, not merely a statement about its pointwise image. Indeed, the equalities from Steps 2--4 give $f_{i(a)}\circ r_a\circ v_{j,k}=e_a\circ p_a\circ v_{j,k}=e_a\circ h_{j,k}\circ t_{j,k}=u_j\circ q_j\circ\iota_{j,k}\circ t_{j,k}$. This is exactly the prescribed composite to $S$. The open covers and first finite locally free maps were supplied in Step 3 and the second finite locally free surjections in Step 4. Their composites are jointly surjective as well: for $s\in S$, choose $j$ with $s\in U_j$, then $w\in W_j$ above $s$, then $k$ with $w\in W_{j,k}$, and finally a point of $T_{j,k}$ above $w$. Smallness follows from small dependent sums of the indexing sets in the fixed universes [def-weil-size-convention].

source.place: Tag 05WN, lemma-dominate-fppf, final sentence: the projection to V_a gives the refinement.

proof_origin.place: Tag 05WN, lemma-dominate-fppf, proof; its cited inputs are Tags 0DET and 02LI.
